name: gitrakz
description: Drive a self-hosted gitrakz instance: sync a GitHub user's activity into local SQLite, query the filterable timeline and derived work sessions, and run deterministic programmatic templates that export to CSV/PDF/JSON — over its bearer-protected /api/v1 REST API.

gitrakz_url.title: gitrakz URL
gitrakz_url.description: Base URL of a gitrakz instance you run, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080.

gitrakz_auth_token.title: gitrakz API token
gitrakz_auth_token.description: Bearer token for /api when GITRAKZ_AUTH_TOKEN is set on the server. Leave empty if the API is open.
